title: anthemis rumelica
intro: Anthemis rumelica, commonly known as Balkan chamomile, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation due to its sedative effects. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis rumelica include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various conditions like insomnia, menstrual cramps, and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Anthemis rumelica include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
